components.label: Powered sub cabinet
components.purpose: 15 mm braced plywood enclosure with EVCoat, 530 wide × 455 high × 551 deep mm and 26.2 kg net, all-metal handles and an 18 AWG powder-coated steel grille.
components.limits: Envelope, weight and materials are official; handle and vent shapes are approximate.

components.label: EVS-15C 15-inch driver
components.purpose: EV-engineered EVS-15C 381 mm woofer with up to 1300 W of class-D power: 133 dB max SPL, 45–150 Hz (−3 dB), 40–180 Hz (−10 dB).

components.label: Inputs · 2 × XLR/TRS combo
components.purpose: Two balanced combo inputs for left and right, or a mono feed from the mixer master.

components.label: Link outputs · 2 × XLR
components.purpose: Two XLR link outputs carrying the input signal on to the tops or another sub; the DSP system-match crossover decides what the tops get.

components.label: QuickSmartDSP LCD and controls
components.purpose: Rear LCD menu with presets, system-match crossovers (low-pass 80/100/120/150 Hz per the seed), limiting and cardioid control for multi-sub arrays with up to 35 dB rejection on stage.
components.limits: Menu layout is approximate; crossover values are from the seed.

components.label: Mains inlet and power switch
components.purpose: IEC inlet; 1.8 A listed power consumption. A variable-speed fan manages heat under load.

components.label: Aluminium pole mount
components.purpose: Threaded aluminium pole mount on top for a satellite top on a pole.

Simulated EKX-15SP state



Connections and controls
Each button only reads back what the manufacturer document says that connector or control does.


Under the ZLX tops
Mixer master into INPUT 1 and 2, LINK outputs up to the ZLX-15BTs. Pick the system-match preset on both ends so the crossover is set once.
Cardioid control only applies with two or more EKX subs.
